Prince William and Princess Kate Visit India for Earthshot Prize

Prince William and Princess Catherine visited India, participating in events related to the Earthshot Prize. Princess Kate delivered a speech at an awards ceremony, hailing the winners of the Earthshot Prize. Their visit included activities such as a metro ride.
